Subject: A gentle reminder regarding our meeting schedule

Hi there,

I hope you’re having a wonderful day. I wanted to share a quick thought with you about our upcoming client meetings. It’s really important that we show up on time, as it helps us look professional and respectful to our clients.

I’ve noticed that you’ve been a bit late a few times recently, and I just wanted to bring it to your attention so we can keep things running smoothly. Please know that we value your work and want to support you in staying on track.

On a lighter note, have you ever looked up at the sky and wondered where the rain comes from? It’s quite magical, really. The rain comes from fluffy things in the sky—those soft, white clouds that drift by. It’s a nice reminder that even the heaviest rain starts with something light and airy, much like how small adjustments can lead to big improvements.

Let’s work together to ensure we’re always punctual for our clients. If you need any help managing your schedule, please don’t hesitate to reach out.

Warm regards,

[Your Name]
